**Subject:** Update on Your Senior Developer Application  

Hi Marcus,

Thank you for taking the time to interview for the Senior Developer role at our Austin office and for sharing your impressive cloud‑architecture expertise and leadership experience with us.  

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with another candidate whose background aligns more closely with our current fintech focus. This decision was not easy, as your qualifications were strong, and we truly appreciate the effort you invested throughout the process.

We wish you continued success in your career and hope our paths may cross again in the future.

Best regards,
